1.2.0: Measures every change it reviews with three quality gates (risky functions, duplicated code, tests that miss broken code) and reports the numbers.
1.1.0: Checks code structure in every review: compares file, function and component sizes before and after the change and flags what grew.
Flags any hard size limit that grew without a written OK, and any third copy of the same code that was neither extracted nor filed.
